subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the metadata-preservation defects are fixed, should OpenClaw accept a configure-time custom-provider metadata editor as the product direction for interactive model metadata setup?
rationale: The line-level defects are mechanically fixable, but adding a persisted setup prompt changes the product boundary across configure, onboard, and non-interactive custom-provider setup flows.

options.title: Accept after preservation fixes
options.body: Land this as the configure-time custom-provider metadata editor once it preserves modalities, API override semantics, and tiered pricing.

options.title: Fold into unified setup design
options.body: Pause this PR and design one metadata setup surface spanning configure, onboard, and non-interactive custom-provider paths.

options.title: Defer to narrower context-window work
options.body: Keep only narrower context-window paths, such as the non-interactive flag PR, and close or replace this broader editor direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after preservation fixes
recommendation.body: Land this as the configure-time custom-provider metadata editor once it preserves modalities, API override semantics, and tiered pricing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and related maintainer context make this the strongest available owner for provider/config command product direction.
